mintAuthority.summary: cgUSD is an ERC-4626 rebasing vault on Base where users mint by depositing USDC/USDT (incl. cross-chain via Axelar), but Cygnus custodies the off-chain U.S. Treasury reserves, controls the daily oracle-reported NAV rebase, and runs an AMO managing on-chain liquidity. Both the vault and oracle are owned by a TimelockController with 10s delay, controlled by a 2/11 Safe as proposer.

sources.label: Base mainnet RPC EIP-1967 slot check

controls.evidence: At Base block 47199109, the cgUSD vault owner() and accounting oracle owner() both return 0xfECAB866b450b97dB38500898e9272c1D18918b7; minDelay() = 10 seconds (essentially no delay); PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE held by 0x188f3264dee2a74c6389c48fb71ae16e2f568722 (2/11 Safe); EXECUTOR_ROLE held by 4 addresses (0xf3d8ce43, 0xe080a417, 0x73e4e2af, 0x8baa9594); DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE self-administered by the timelock; no RoleRevoked events found. RoleGranted logs confirmed via Base Blockscout.

review.evidence: At Base block 47199109: cgUSD vault owner() = TimelockController 0xfECAB866; accounting oracle owner() = same; TimelockController minDelay = 10s; PROPOSER_ROLE = 2/11 Safe (0x188f3264, getOwners returns 11, getThreshold = 2); EXECUTOR_ROLE held by 4 contracts; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE self-held; no modules on the Safe proposer or the timelock. All mint-capable controls confirmed from chain state. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the 2/11 Safe controls mint and NAV authority through an effectively immediate 10-second timelock, while no independent whole-supply reconciliation or prudential authorization is evidenced.
